text:
Leah S.: pushed a tiny prototype for sampled invocation estimates in Console (5% default). Please review.
Tom (infra): link?
Leah S.: https://git.internal/r/redwood/console/feature/sampled-inv-ui
Ravi: Important to attach route_id, model_sku, cache_hit, and sample_policy_id to each row so we can stratify.
Tom (infra): we already emit sample_rate; adding weight=1.0/sample_rate per-row ok. watch partitioning.
design-bot: mock uploaded: https://design.internal/sampled-card.png
Leah S.: UX: badge "sampled" + CI on hover, collapsed by default. never replace billing panel.
Ravi: We'll keep p50/p95 token metrics for variance. flag routes with sampled_count < 50.
Tom (infra): ops: need migration to add weight and p50/p95 columns. schedule maintenance?
Leah S.: I'll open RFC. plan to run replay job to compare estimate vs full capture for a heavy route.
deploy-bot: deploy started: telemetry-sampled (sha: d9f0c)
Tom (infra): also expose API to bump sampling on a route for short windows.
Leah S.: acceptance: label, sample rate, CI, docs page. will post replay results tomorrow.
Ravi: SGTM
